experiment.title: Exact FNSPID negative-pressure HAR transfer to the backward LSEG window
experiment.objective: Test the unchanged FNSPID aggregate negative-pressure hysteresis rule on the earlier, non-pooled Reuters LSEG block after extending the local LSEG S&P 500 open-price history.
experiment.evidence_role: bounded historical cross-source and external-time robustness

backward_finbert_firm_open.role: decision-period pinned-FinBERT negative pressure; use sessions strictly before 2025-10-27

notebook_72_spec.role: unchanged sentiment, portfolio, inference and gate contract

inputs_known_at_freeze.source_regime: Reuters LSEG only; no FNSPID observations are pooled

price_acquisition.return_convention: split-adjusted open-to-open price returns; dividends not back-adjusted

decision_window.rule: all backward FinBERT firm-open sessions strictly before 2025-10-27
decision_window.incomplete_sessions: retain as decision sessions; pressure is missing and hysteresis retains its prior state
decision_window.return: current session open to next S&P 500 open

input_only_feasibility_observed_before_r.interpretation: sufficient state variation to run the frozen economic and timing tests

sentiment_rule.daily_pressure: headline-count-weighted negative-story share across complete 33-company sessions
sentiment_rule.normalisation: current pressure minus strictly prior rolling mean, divided by strictly prior rolling standard deviation
sentiment_rule.missing_z: retain previous state; before the first valid z-score remain risk-on

portfolio.base: Notebook 21 control HAR fit on FNSPID 2011-2019, transferred unchanged
portfolio.composition: base HAR exposure multiplied by 1.0 or 0.25
portfolio.matched_control: constant multiplier chosen only to equal the overlay's mean exposure

primary_family: overlay minus HAR mean net return
inference.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across the two two-sided primary tests at q=0.05
inference.matched_exposure_attribution: overlay minus constant-multiplier net return and downside reduction
inference.timing_placebo: all circular placements of the unchanged binary multiplier; one-sided exact return and downside p-values corrected as a two-test family

gates.return_gate: return interval lower bound above zero, BH q below 0.05, Sharpe improvement at least 0.10, and non-negative overlay-minus-HAR mean in both halves
gates.useful_risk_gate: downside interval lower bound above zero, BH q below 0.05, relative drawdown improvement at least 10 percent, return interval lower bound no worse than -1 bp per session, and non-negative overlay Sharpe in both halves
gates.timing_gate: observed downside reduction exceeds the mean shifted reduction and its one-sided BH q is below 0.05
gates.cross_source_support: at least the useful-risk gate and timing gate must pass

claim_boundaries: The LSEG news inputs and input-only state activation were examined before price acquisition; the historical S&P 500 outcomes were not locally available when this specification was frozen.
This is a bounded historical robustness test, not a prospective or preregistered confirmation.
No scorer, threshold, state rule, rolling window, exposure multiplier, cost, comparison, inference family or gate may change after price acquisition.
The backward and recent Reuters regimes remain reported separately and are never pooled to create a success claim.
A failed result is preserved and is not permission to reverse, lower or otherwise tune the threshold.
The separate materiality 2026 confirmation remains sealed.
